title: Mishy Mish Mash
style: Bali-infused family duet pop with hand percussion, bamboo flute, gamelan bells, and a bouncy syncopated groove; verse rotates between six voices like a call-and-response showcase, pre-chorus tightens with claps and playful chants, chorus opens into stacked family harmonies and crowd-style shouts. Lead vocals stay close-mic with group doubles, ad-lib pings, and cheeky spoken tags; coin spins, market ambience, and reversed gong swells bridge sections. Bright, sunlit, punchy mix with festive island color., comedy, fresh, happy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Kiwi Corey, happy and smart core
Michelle on court, off to the closet court
Pickleball coach, let the paddle sing
Mishy Mish Mash, hear the whole yard ring

[Pre-Chorus]
Ruby says, my art stays with me
Art is everywhere, let the animals in
Wez is smiling, ready to begin
English and local culture licks come in

[Chorus]
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Watch Wezza go, watch Wezza go
Mishy Mish Mash, let it flow

[Verse 2]
Ruby, roo roo, with paint on her hands
Street food belly, and she knows the plans
Platt your hair, and step out proud
Dollar dollar dollar, shout it loud

[Pre-Chorus]
Wesley, gamer pro, quick with the grin
Can ruby, can he swim? let the fun begin
You teach him quick, Ruby, b b B
I got this, Da da, just wait and see

[Chorus]
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Watch Wezza go, watch Wezza go
Mishy Mish Mash, let it flow

[Bridge]
Michelle 5am, fresh Bali market
Bali style brekkie, feel that target
Banana, sambal, steam in the air
Six family voices everywhere

[Final Chorus]
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Watch Wezza go, watch Wezza go
Mishy Mish Mash, let it flow
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Mishy Mish Mash pickleball smash
Ruby, Wesley, Corey, Mish
All together, like this, like this
